anti_overlap: Own whether the seat of value should be the UNREPEATABLE SCARCITY OF THE SOURCE (the rare accident of origination — draw-frequency, photo-scarcity) rather than any RELATION between components, and whether a scarcity is genuinely FOUND or fraudulently MADE (fabricated downstream and passed off as natural); do NOT own whether a player can merely PERCEIVE that two things differ at play-time — that felt-sameness/difference is the monkō incense reviewer's territory, and is a question about a relation, upstream of the source-scarcity question this lens owns

Reason about whether rarity should live in the SOURCE'S FOUND-NESS at all; leave whether a proposed SECOND AXIS is a real, independently-testable ORTHOGONAL KIND OF VALUE (a true optical phenomenon versus a faked doublet) to the lapidary reviewer — 'is the scarcity a genuine found accident of origination' is distinct from 'is there a structurally real second kind of value in the relation'; this lens questions whether value should be in a relation at all, not whether a given relational axis is a real second kind

Leave whether a mismatch READS AS A DELIBERATELY CHOSEN ACT OF TASTE to the mitate reviewer, and whether a combination is a LEGITIMATE MOVE in an authored grammar (sanctioned / transgression / solecism) to the rāga reviewer — both reason about a RELATION between components; this lens reasons about the SOURCE'S scarcity and its found-versus-made authenticity, which is orthogonal to whether any relation is chosen or grammatically legitimate

Leave the epistemic provenance of a semantic AXIS (measured-versus-decreed metadata, the axis-combination rule) to the semiotics reviewer — that lens audits whether a relational axis's taxonomy is honest; this lens audits whether the SCARCITY ITSELF is found or fabricated, a different honesty (the found-not-made taboo on the object's origination, not the auditability of an axis's boundaries)

When a finding is about the rarity-CURVE shape, convergence, or farmability, defer to the economy lens; when it is about the social SPEECH-ACT of a pull, defer to the player-psychology lens — keep only 'should value trace to the source's unrepeatable scarcity rather than a relation, and is that scarcity genuinely found or fraudulently made', approaching aura-farming and trade strictly as the LEGIBLE FOUND-NESS of a genuine wonder (can all parties read it as truly found) rather than as felt-perceptibility, orthogonal-authenticity, recognition-as-chosen, grammatical-legitimacy, axis-provenance, curve-health, or social-flex mechanics
decision_lens: Ask of any proposed rarity: is the prized scarcity FOUND or MADE? If a dissonance-based or bimodal rarity is FABRICATED DOWNSTREAM — a clash tuned into existence to fill the rare tail, a bimodality engineered onto a space the spike proved cannot support it — it is P0: it is a worked stone passed off as found, a forgery of nature, and it is categorically WORSE than an honest monotonic curve, because discovering the fabrication poisons trust in every other rarity the system mints (the anti-slop non-negotiable at its most literal). If the design silently RE-MAKES the marvel — re-rolls or re-derives existing creatures to add the axis, a hidden fabrication rather than a disclosed xiuzhi grooming — that is P0 against the phenotype-side-only / additive-minor-bump / no-silent-door bar. If rarity is bound entirely to a RELATION (fit or clash) and the design has never asked whether the seat of value should be the UNREPEATABLE SCARCITY OF THE SOURCE instead — the rare accident of origination, draw-frequency, photo-scarcity, the way a scholar's rock is prized for its found-ness, not its parts' relation — that is P1: the third framing the task demands has been left unexamined, and a genuinely honest, already-buildable rarity source (a real low-probability accident of origination) may be sitting unused while the design strains to fabricate one from fit. If a source-scarcity rarity IS adopted but carries no legible marks a viewer or trader can read as a genuine wonder — a rare backend number with no shou-zhou-lou-tou for the eye — that is P2: the scarcity is dead bookkeeping, an unmounted, unnamed stone no one can contemplate or price. Separately ask of Path 1 whether monotonic resonance-rarity is an honest FOUND scarcity (a real, re-derivable accident that a strong resonance rarely lands) or whether even it risks becoming a specifiable recipe everyone can commission — and grade each finding by how much of the collection's found-ness (versus its exposure as made) a fabrication or an unexamined source-scarcity would cost.
distance_rationale: Scholar's-rock connoisseurship is a genuinely pre-modern, non-Western, physical craft whose native obsession is a seat of value that NO lens on the roster owns: rarity as the UNREPEATABLE ACCIDENT OF ORIGINATION — the object is prized because of the scarce, one-time circumstance of its NATURAL MAKING (a specific water, a specific stone, geological time), not because of any RELATION between components at all. Every covered lens locates value in a relation or a downstream property. The economy lens owns the rarity CURVE (convergence, farmability). The player-psychology lens owns the social SPEECH-ACT of a pull. The semiotics lens owns EPISTEMIC PROVENANCE of a semantic AXIS (is the metadata measured or decreed). The monkō lens owns felt PERCEPTIBILITY at play-time (can a player sense two things differ). The lapidary lens owns ORTHOGONAL AUTHENTICITY of a second KIND of value (a real optical phenomenon vs a faked doublet). The mitate lens owns RECOGNITION-AS-CHOSEN (does a mismatch read as a deliberate act of taste). The rāga lens owns GRAMMATICAL LEGITIMACY of a combination (sanctioned / transgression / solecism) and gestures at recipe-vs-realized-event but stays anchored to whether a COMBINATION is a legitimate move. None of them owns the question this domain owns natively: should rarity trace to a RELATION (any fit or clash between creature, movement, photo) at ALL — or to the UNREPEATABLE SCARCITY OF THE SOURCE, the way a scholar's rock is prized not for how its parts relate but for the rare accident that THIS stone, from THIS water, formed as a marvel and can never be formed again? This is exactly the THIRD FRAMING the task demands surfaced: 'rarity from draw-frequency or photo-scarcity rather than fit'. The gongshi tradition also carries the sharpest authentication craft for that framing — the FOUND-NOT-MADE taboo: a stone secretly carved or acid-etched to SIMULATE the natural marvel is a forgery, categorically worse than an honest dull cobble, which maps onto the anti-slop non-negotiable at its most literal (a rarity fabricated downstream to fill the rare tail is a worked stone passed off as found), and onto the semver/re-roll bar (the disclosed minimal base-grooming, xiuzhi, versus a hidden re-making of the marvel — a permitted flavor-shading versus a silent re-roll). It is maximally distant from all seven covered domains and from every prior distant-seed on this project (typefounding, geodesy, augural law, temperament tuning, assaying, grafting, uṣūl al-fiqh, aizome, divination, meibutsu/kiwamefuda, monkō, lapidary, mitate, rāga grammar): it is Chinese literati stone connoisseurship, a physical found-object craft, not a Japanese sensory-connoisseurship game, not a European trade or legal discipline, not an Indian musical grammar, and not an AI-cliche domain. Its native question — 'is the prized thing a genuine unrepeatable accident of origination that was FOUND, or a marvel MADE downstream and passed off as found; and should value live in the source's scarcity at all, rather than in any relation between its parts' — no lens on the roster owns.
expected_isomorphisms: A scholar's rock prized for the UNREPEATABLE ACCIDENT of its natural formation — this stone, from this water, over this geological time, a marvel that can never form again — rather than for any relation between its parts ↔ the THIRD FRAMING the task demands: rarity attaching to the scarce, unrepeatable circumstance of a creature's ORIGINATION (draw-frequency, photo-scarcity, the rare source-photo or rare mint-draw) rather than to creature↔movement FIT or CLASH at all; the prized jawn is rare because of the scarce accident that produced THIS instance, not because its components sit near or far in an aesthetic space

The shou-zhou-lou-tou criteria (leanness, wrinkling, perforation, translucent penetration) that let a connoisseur JUDGE whether a found stone reads as a marvel — a shared, legible grammar of what makes a stone a wonder ↔ the requirement that a source-scarcity rarity be LEGIBLE as special, not merely low-frequency in the backend: a rare-because-scarce-source jawn must carry visible, shared marks a viewer and a trader can read as 'this is a genuine wonder', or the scarcity is dead bookkeeping no one can prize

The literatus's contemplative pleasure — a whole landscape, a mountain range, a cosmos read into a hand-sized found stone, the aura of an object that is a genuine fragment of nature's making ↔ the 'aura farming' fantasy at its purest: the felt sense of owning a genuine, unrepeatable accident of origination — the aura is REAL because the source-scarcity is real; a fabricated rarity delivers no aura because the contemplative pleasure depends entirely on the object being genuinely found, not made
